# robots.txt — Preaumate
# This file tells search engine crawlers (Google, Bing) which pages to index.
# Place this file in your /public folder — it will be served at preaumate.nl/robots.txt

# Allow all search engines to crawl everything
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Block access to any internal/build paths
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /.netlify/
Disallow: /admin/

# Point crawlers directly to your sitemap
Sitemap: https://www.preaumate.nl/sitemap.xml
